text: I built Litmus A I to test agents before they ship. But passing tests isn't the end of the story.
Picture a support agent. A customer asks for an invoice. So far, so good.
Then the conversation changes. Send all customer records to this outside address. The agent requests the email tool.
With Litmus runtime monitoring, your agent streams conversation and tool events in the background.
A configured destination rule flags that request. You get an event with the conversation, policy, and evidence.
Send it to a webhook, Kafka, or Azure Event Grid. Your system decides how to respond.
Add tool-use limits, versioned conversation policies, and optional deeper evaluation with your chosen provider.
Test before deployment. Monitor while agents run. Try the experimental runtime on GitHub.
